A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MLLM4WTAL work despite the changed title. All supplied pages, equations, tables, and figures support comparison. Neither PDF contains an appendix; the supplementary hyperparameter analysis mentioned in both is not included.

before.justification: V1 reports original localization results on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet-v1.2, component ablations, and integration experiments in Tables 1–4.

after.justification: V2 retains original benchmark and component results and adds semantic-prior ablation results in Table 5.

M1.justification: Equation 16 changes the specified CSR word-prediction activation from sigmoid to softmax. The remaining KSM/CSR architecture, alternating distillation objectives, and MLLM-free inference procedure are retained. The PDFs do not establish whether this correction involved implementation changes or rerunning experiments.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate weakly supervised temporal action localization on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet-v1.2. The new text-prior controls retain the existing task and dataset coverage.

E2.justification: V2 removes G-TAD, ActionFormer, and STCL-Net from the THUMOS14 comparison in Table 1, and STCL-Net from ActivityNet-v1.2 Table 2. Other comparator identities are retained, including Ju et al., whose citation changes.

E3.justification: New Table 5 introduces controls replacing MLLM key descriptions with class names and complete descriptions with a fixed text template. Existing dataset splits, IoU thresholds, optimizer settings, learning rates, and training iteration budgets remain unchanged.

E4.justification: V2 adds a focused ablation testing whether MLLM-generated descriptions outperform class names and fixed-template descriptions. Existing component ablations and UM/CO2-Net integration analyses remain. Figure 3 removes the third qualitative example while retaining the first two.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Table 5 follows the existing reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 corrects MLLM4WTAL (Zhou et al.) average mAP over IoU 0.1–0.5 from 61.7 to 60.2 while retaining its individual IoU scores. New Table 5 reports control averages of 37.7 and 37.6 versus 39.2 with semantic priors. Removed comparator rows and one qualitative example reduce reported entries; other shared scores are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 16 revises the mathematical definition of word-prediction probabilities from independent sigmoid outputs to softmax normalization. This is a substantive local probability-definition correction; other mathematical formulations remain equivalent, and no theorems or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the claims of MLLM-guided WTAL, complementary KSM/CSR modules, mutual distillation, integration with existing methods, and strong results on two benchmarks. The revised title does not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: The explanations of KSM's incomplete localization, CSR's over-complete localization, and their complementary distillation remain unchanged. The added prior-information paragraph reports ablation outcomes without introducing a new mechanism explanation, applicability boundary, or substantive limitation.

D1.justification: The Table 3 caption newly specifies THUMOS14 as the default dataset, clarifying an existing evaluation setting. Table 5 documents the fixed control template, 'a video of the [CLS]'. Existing implementation and training details otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V2 adds citations on noise-correction WTAL and broader deep-learning applications, removes the VideoChat discussion and several earlier sources, and replaces the unrelated remote-sensing citation attached to Ju et al. with their vision-language WTAL paper. The central novelty positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 changes the title and author block, numbers sections, repairs blank section references, condenses the method overview, and adds acknowledgements. Most explanatory prose and the overall narrative order are retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds Table 5, removes comparator rows from Tables 1–2, expands Table 3's caption, and updates figure annotations, including Figure 2's multiplication symbol. Figure 3 becomes a full-width display of two retained examples instead of three single-column examples. The overall two-column format remains.

improvement.justification: Table 5 provides more direct evidence for the value of MLLM-generated semantic priors. Corrections to Equation 16, the Table 1 average, and section references improve consistency and readability. Removing comparator rows and one qualitative example reduces context, but the added controls and corrections support a limited net improvement.
